# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Gemini Adds Agentic Video Search With Fewer Tokens](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-agentic-video-understanding.html): Google’s Gemini models can now choose which moments of a video to inspect, reducing token use while improving retrieval accuracy.
- [MiniMax Adapts H3 Video Model Into Interactive World Engine](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/hailuo-h3-interactive-world-adapter.html): A lightweight MiniMax experiment turns H3’s learned video dynamics into an interactive environment using only 8,000 samples.
- [Meta Launches Muse Voice Transcribe for Streaming Audio](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-voice-transcribe.html): Meta’s first real-time audio perception model processes speech in 80-millisecond chunks, supports more than 70 languages and adapts its delay to balance speed and accuracy.
- [OpenAI Classifies Astra as Cyber-Critical Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-astra-cyber-critical.html): OpenAI says its unreleased Astra model can autonomously discover and exploit unknown flaws, prompting tighter release controls.
- [Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-Max-0902 Takes Code Arena Lead](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-max-code-arena-lead.html): Alibaba’s updated flagship model tops a major web-development benchmark while retaining a million-token context window.
- [World Labs Unveils Atlas Spatial Foundation Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/world-labs-atlas-model.html): Atlas combines generation, 3D reconstruction and simulation in one architecture aimed at filmmaking, robotics and virtual worlds.
- [Google TimesFM-3 Adds Zero-Shot Multivariate Forecasts](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-timesfm3-multivariate-forecasting.html): The 330-million-parameter model forecasts related series and external variables without task-specific fine-tuning.
- [Manus Resumes Independent Operations After Meta Split](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/manus-resumes-independent-operations.html): The agent developer is again operating independently after a disruptive separation from Meta, with its founding team continuing to lead the company.
- [Microsoft Shrinks Pathology Models for Cohort-Scale AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/microsoft-flash-pathology-models.html): Open-weight GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash sharply reduce compute and memory needs while retaining research performance.
- [Ollama Replaces Usage Windows With Per-Token Pricing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ollama-adopts-token-pricing.html): Ollama has replaced opaque GPU-time limits with published token rates and monthly credits across its paid cloud plans.
- [Runway Solaris Generates Interfaces Without Coded Apps](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/runway-solaris-generated-interfaces.html): The research system renders interactive 720p interfaces frame by frame, extending generative video into software and agent training.
- [Together AI, HUMAIN Plan 250MW Saudi AI Data Center](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/together-humain-saudi-ai-campus.html): The partners say the project will nearly triple Together AI’s capacity and support more than $5 billion in annualized revenue.
- [EU Places ChatGPT Search Under Its Strictest Platform Rules](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/chatgpt-eu-search-engine-designation.html): ChatGPT Search must undergo systemic-risk reviews and independent audits after crossing the EU’s 45-million-user threshold.
- [DiDi Starts Driverless Passenger Trials With R2 Robotaxi](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/didi-r2-driverless-passenger-trials.html): Passengers in parts of Beijing and Guangzhou can now summon DiDi’s purpose-built R2, equipped with 33 sensors and redundant controls.
- [OpenClaw 2.0 Turns Personal Agents Into a Shared Platform](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openclaw-two-agent-platform.html): The open-source agent adds remote sessions, interactive dashboards and scoped secret handling in a major architectural overhaul.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Gemini 推出智能体式视频理解能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-agentic-video-understanding.html): Gemini 可自行判断视频中哪些时段值得细看，在提升检索准确率的同时，将词元消耗最多降低 88%。
- [MiniMax以轻量训练将H3改造成交互式世界引擎](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/hailuo-h3-interactive-world-adapter.html): MiniMax用8000条样本和不足千分之二的可训练参数，将H3视频模型中的动态知识转化为可交互环境。
- [Meta 推出实时语音模型 Muse Voice Transcribe](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-voice-transcribe.html): Meta首款实时音频感知模型以80毫秒为单位处理语音，覆盖70多种语言，并通过自适应等待在速度与准确率之间动态取舍。
- [OpenAI 将 Astra 列为关键级网络安全模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-astra-cyber-critical.html): 尚未发布的 Astra 据称可自主发现未知漏洞并设计利用方式，OpenAI 因此推迟部分开发并收紧敏感能力访问。
- [阿里升级Qwen3.8-Max，登顶网页开发竞技场](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-max-code-arena-lead.html): 阿里发布Qwen3.8-Max-0902，在保留百万上下文与多模态能力的同时，登上Code Arena网页开发榜首。
- [World Labs 发布空间基础模型 Atlas](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/world-labs-atlas-model.html): Atlas 用统一架构完成生成、三维重建与模拟，目标覆盖影视制作、机器人训练和虚拟世界开发。
- [谷歌发布TimesFM-3，零样本预测拓展至多变量场景](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-timesfm3-multivariate-forecasting.html): 这款3.3亿参数模型无需针对任务微调，即可联合预测关联序列并利用促销、天气等外部变量。
- [Manus结束与Meta拆分，正式恢复独立运营](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/manus-resumes-independent-operations.html): 经历数据迁移和短暂停服后，Manus正式完成与Meta的拆分，创始团队将继续领导这家通用智能体公司。
- [微软压缩病理基础模型，推动大规模患者队列研究](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/microsoft-flash-pathology-models.html): 开放权重的GigaPath-Flash与GigaTIME-Flash大幅降低算力和显存需求，同时保持研究基准表现。
- [Ollama取消时段限额，云服务改按词元计费](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ollama-adopts-token-pricing.html): Ollama以公开词元价格和月度积分池取代难以预测的GPU时长限制，并正式开放团队套餐。
- [Runway发布Solaris，以实时生成画面取代固定应用界面](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/runway-solaris-generated-interfaces.html): 这套研究系统逐帧生成可交互的720p界面，将视频生成能力延伸至软件形态和智能体训练环境。
- [Together AI与HUMAIN将在沙特建设250兆瓦AI数据中心](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/together-humain-saudi-ai-campus.html): 双方称项目将使Together AI可用算力接近增至三倍，并有望承载超过50亿美元的年化收入。
- [欧盟将ChatGPT搜索纳入最严格平台监管](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/chatgpt-eu-search-engine-designation.html): ChatGPT搜索在欧盟月均用户约1.59亿，跨过《数字服务法》门槛，须接受系统性风险评估与独立审计。
- [滴滴新一代R2 Robotaxi开启无人载客测试](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/didi-r2-driverless-passenger-trials.html): 滴滴与广汽埃安联合打造的R2已在北京、广州部分区域开放呼叫，搭载33个传感器及多重安全冗余系统。
- [OpenClaw 2.0将个人智能体升级为协作平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openclaw-two-agent-platform.html): OpenClaw完成架构级更新，新增跨设备会话、交互式看板和受控密钥调用，向持续运行的智能体平台迈进。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs

- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-09-02.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
